  • Hands-on daily work in a CRM and a disciplined qualification method (e.g. MEDDPICC): your forecast is something the company can plan on
  • Closer's mindset: you treat an opportunity without a next step and a date as a problem, not a pipeline entry
  • Structured working style: your offers, decisions and customer commitments are written down so that Operations, the field team and the founders can act on them without asking
  • Willingness to travel 30–50 % across Germany and Europe, occasionally beyond Europe

Nice to Have

You will tackle challenges involving latency, throughput, memory efficiency, and scalability, including deployment on resource-constrained mobile and edge devices.
The role combines hands-on research with low-level engineering, giving you the opportunity to develop novel inference strategies and GPU kernels.
You will work with complex architectures spanning text, image, audio, diffusion models, and vision transformers.
Your work will involve rigorous benchmarking, production testing, and iterative optimization to translate research into measurable performance improvements.
You will collaborate with cross-functional teams in a highly technical, remote environment focused on pushing the boundaries of efficient AI systems.

  • Design and deploy advanced model-serving architectures optimized for high throughput, low latency, and efficient memory utilization.
  • Develop inference pipelines capable of operating effectively across diverse environments, including resource-constrained mobile devices and edge platforms.
  • Establish clear performance targets covering response latency, token generation speed, throughput, memory footprint, and reliability.
  • Build and execute controlled inference benchmarks in simulated and production environments, tracking latency, throughput, memory consumption, and error rates.
  • Create and maintain representative datasets and simulation scenarios for evaluating model performance under real-world and resource-constrained conditions.
  • Identify computational and memory bottlenecks across inference pipelines and implement solutions involving batching, networking, memory management, and other system-level optimizations.
  • Develop custom GPU kernels and compute shaders for mobile hardware, including solutions written in Metal Shading Language (MSL).

  • Work with cross-functional engineering and research teams to integrate optimized inference frameworks into production and edge-device applications.

    • Requirements:

    • Track record of delivering measurable improvements in inference latency, throughput, and memory footprint for domain-specific applications.

jobs.title: Post-doctorant.e "Nouvelles méthodologies Auger pour l'analyse quantitative de la ségrégation interfaciale dans les aciers faiblement alliés" - CDD 24 mois
jobs.description:
Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

Bienvenue dans l’univers des matériaux du futur !

Au centre Science des Matériaux et des Structures (SMS), rattaché au Laboratoire Georges Friedel (unité mixte de recherche CNRS), on décortique la matière pour mieux la maîtriser. Alliages métalliques, céramiques, composites… ici, on explore le lien entre procédés, microstructures et propriétés des matériaux.

Grâce à des outils de caractérisation avancée et des modèles multi-échelles, nos enseignants-chercheurs inventent le concept de « Material by design » : concevoir les matériaux dès l’atelier de recherche, pour une performance sur-mesure.

🧠 Vous aimez la science fondamentale qui change le réel ? C’est ici que ça se passe.

🎯 Description du poste - ce que nous attendons de vous

Le Laboratoire Georges Friedel (LGF) est une Unité Mixte de Recherche du CNRS (UMR 5307). Situé à l’École des Mines de Saint-Étienne et porté par deux tutelles (Mines Saint-Étienne et CNRS), le laboratoire regroupe tout le potentiel de recherche de Mines Saint-Étienne dans les domaines des matériaux, de la mécanique et des procédés.

Le centre SMS - Sciences des Matériaux et des Structures - est l’un des cinq centres d’enseignement et de recherche de Mines Saint-Etienne. Au sein du LGF, il développe des recherches en science des matériaux, mécanique et procédés avancés de fabrication, pour le transport et la production d'énergie, avec un objectif d’accroître la durabilité des matériaux.

Ce post-doc s'inscrit dans le cadre de la chaire « SIRA », un partenariat de quatre ans entre Mines Saint-Etienne et les sociétés Framatome et EDF, co-financé par l'Agence Nationale de la Recherche, portant sur le vieillissement des aciers faiblement alliés (16MND5) utilisés dans les composants du circuit primaire des réacteurs nucléaires à eau pressurisée.

Ce post-doc est organisé selon quatre axes de travail.

Le premier axe de travail concernera l’utilisation de l’hydrogène pour favoriser la rupture intergranulaire, préalable indispensable à la spectrométrie Auger sur fracture. Ceci permettra d’accéder à des niveaux de ségrégation faibles, insuffisants pour provoquer une fragilité intergranulaire « intrinsèque ». L’hydrogène est connu pour exacerber, dans certains cas, la fragilité intergranulaire. Il s’agira ici d’explorer les conditions dans lesquelles on peut obtenir pour l’acier de cuve des ruptures intergranulaires assistées par l’hydrogène. On pourra notamment étudier l’effet de la concentration d’hydrogène (introduit par chargement cathodique par exemple) et de la vitesse de sollicitation mécanique. La chaire pourra bénéficier ici des compétences du laboratoire sur la fragilisation par l'hydrogène.

Le deuxième axe de travail porte sur le développement d'un modèle quantitatif pour l'analyse par Auger de la ségrégation intergranulaire des éléments d'alliages. Il s'agira d'une approche similaire à celle déjà développée pour le phosphore et le soufre, avec la difficulté supplémentaire de soustraire la contribution du volume, ici non-négligeable.

Les troisième et quatrième axes de ce post-doc s'appuient sur le spectromètre Auger installé en décembre 2025. Cet équipement de dernière génération présente une résolution latérale inférieure à 10 nm. Ceci ouvre de nouvelles perspectives d'analyses que nous souhaitons explorer dans le cadre de la chaire, en particulier concernant l'analyse du carbone et des carbures, qui constitue le troisième axe de travail de ce post-doc. L'analyse Auger de la surface des carbures nanométriques devient possible avec le nouvel instrument et permet d'accéder à la composition chimique des interfaces carbures-matrice. De plus, l'analyse Auger des facettes intergranulaires pourra être faite en-dehors des carbures et permettra d'accéder à la quantification du carbone ségrégé dans le joint.

Enfin, le dernier axe de travail consistera à développer une méthode de quantification de la ségrégation intergranulaire sans rupture. Il s’agira de travailler ici sur une coupe polie du matériau à étudier et à réaliser des analyses locales, par exemple des profils de concentrations à travers les joints de grains.

Compte tenu de l'excellente résolution latérale, on peut ainsi espérer détecter la ségrégation par cette méthode. Une méthode de traitement des données devra être développée pour accéder à des concentrations intergranulaires de solutés. Une telle méthode a déjà été mise au point pour des analyses réalisées par nanoSIMS et pourrait être transposée sur la spectrométrie Auger. Elle permettrait de s’affranchir de la nécessité d'obtenir une rupture intergranulaire (particulièrement limitante en spectrométrie Auger), tout en conservant une préparation d’échantillon très simple (coupe polie) et une productivité potentiellement importante (grand nombre de joints analysables dans un échantillon donné).

jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Lumai is moving from breakthrough optical-compute research to production AI systems. We need an engineer to build the performance and power modelling capability that guides architecture and compiler decisions before silicon exists, helping us turn a working system into a competitive product.

The Role

You will own the performance and power modelling framework that predicts how Lumai’s photonic AI hardware will perform against real inference workloads. Your models will give architecture and compiler teams a shared source of truth for latency, throughput and power across hardware configurations.

The hard part is balancing speed, fidelity and usability: you will model concurrency, event-driven behaviour and compute-block latency at enough detail to support decisions, while keeping simulations fast enough to compare configurations in minutes. You will characterise operator-level workloads against hardware, RTL or emulation results so the model stays grounded in evidence.

By month six, you will have established a reliable modelling flow for priority workloads and device configurations, demonstrated a clear path for closing gaps between model and hardware, and made the simulator a tool that architecture and compiler teams use to make decisions. You will report to the Head of Architecture or VP Engineering and may build and lead a small team around this capability.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build and maintain a Python-based framework that models hardware and software latency, hardware concurrency and event-driven relationships.

  • Model compute engines, interconnect and synchronisation fabric, memory and bridge interfaces, and accelerator blocks across device configurations.

  • Characterise convolution, depthwise convolution, pooling, attention and other operator workloads against hardware, RTL or emulation results.

  • Build compiler-agnostic interfaces that ingest compiled models and MLIR from multiple internal compiler flows.

  • Analyse simulation traces with architecture and compiler teams to improve layer-to-hardware mappings and resolve performance discrepancies.

  • Run industry benchmarks and representative models, including UL Procyon, Geekbench AI, Stable Diffusion and contemporary LLMs, to produce decision-ready KPIs.

  • Develop block-level power models and validate worst-case power scenarios with micro-architecture, verification and physical-design teams.

  • Own the CI/CD pipelines and simulation flows that keep results reliable and reproducible as usage scales.

  • Translate modelling findings into architecture and compiler decisions, while setting technical direction and developing engineers or interns as the team grows.

What We're Looking For

Must-have

  • Proven experience building or substantially extending a hardware/software performance-modelling or simulation framework for AI/ML accelerators, ideally in Python.

  • Strong understanding of hardware concurrency, event-driven modelling, and AI inference accelerator micro-architecture, including compute, memory hierarchy, interconnect and dataflow.

  • Hands-on experience characterising AI operators and correlating model predictions with real hardware or hardware-accurate reference data.

  • Familiarity with compiler internals and intermediate representations such as MLIR, including tooling that consumes compiler output to drive simulation.

  • Strong software-engineering and technical-leadership practice, including framework design, CI/CD ownership and direction or review of work by junior engineers or interns.

Strong preference for

  • Direct experience with NPU, GPU or other edge or client AI inference accelerator architectures.

  • Experience working across multiple compiler toolchains and reconciling architecture-level and production compiler behaviour.

  • Exposure to power modelling, RTL, emulation, FPGA prototyping, photonic compute or another non-traditional compute architecture.

About Lumai

Lumai is the optical compute company building the next generation of AI infrastructure. Spun out of optics research at the University of Oxford in 2021, we compute with light instead of electrons. Our 3D optical technology carries out the matrix multiplications at the heart of AI inside beams of light travelling through free space, which lets it go beyond the limits of both silicon GPUs and integrated photonics.

In April 2026 we launched Iris Nova, the world's first optical computing system to run billion-parameter large language models in real time, using up to 90% less energy than conventional GPU-based systems. Iris Nova, the first server in the family, is now available for evaluation by hyperscalers, neoclouds, enterprises and research institutions. Aura and Tetra will follow.

Our work won the Falling Walls Award for Science Breakthrough of the Year 2025 and 'Best Overall Technology' at the OCP Future Technologies Symposium. We are headquartered in Oxford.

Why Lumai

You'll work on a new kind of computer. Optical computing for AI has been promised for decades. We have a working system running real models, and the hard part left is taking it to volume.

Your work ships. We are moving from first product to volume production, so what you build this year goes into the servers our customers run.

You'll work across disciplines. Optical engineers, machine learning researchers, and hardware and software engineers solve problems together. You will learn things that don't appear on your job description.

The work matters beyond Lumai. AI's appetite for energy is one of the defining constraints of the next decade. Our mission is sustainable intelligence at global scale: AI that is faster, cheaper to run and far less power-hungry.

You'll join early. You'll have a real say in how we build the product, the team and the way we work.

Equal Opportunity

Lumai is an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions based on skills, experience and potential, and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. If you need an adjustment at any stage of the hiring process, let us know and we will do our best to support you.

Building a single motion that serves both, without compromising either, is one of the central challenges of this role.

  • Own the EMEA Enterprise number, driving pipeline generation, win rate, average deal size, sales cycle length, and quota attainment

  • Get hands-on in your team's most strategic deals, joining customer conversations, coaching in the moment, and helping close the deals that set the standard for what Enterprise looks like at Vanta

  • Hire, mentor, and develop your Managers and AEs as the team scales, and create clear career paths into Enterprise and leadership roles

  • Deliver an accurate weekly forecast, and build the inspection cadence, deal reviews and pipeline hygiene that make it trustworthy

  • Partner with senior sales leadership, marketing, RevOps, product marketing, partnerships and enablement to align the region around a unified GTM strategy

  • Represent Vanta at industry events and customer meetings across the region

How to be successful in this role:

  • Proven, repeated track record as a builder: creating Enterprise playbooks from scratch rather than inheriting them, and taking a company or region upmarket from mid-market roots

  • Experience leading frontline sales leaders at a SaaS company.

  • Consistent record of achieving and exceeding Enterprise new business targets across multiple EMEA markets, with a real understanding of how buying behavior, procurement and security review differ across the region

  • Comfort operating across a broad segment, from a high volume of mid-sized deals through to large, complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals

  • Mastery of a value-based selling methodology such as Command of the Message, and the ability to coach it rather than just quote it

  • Rigorous command of the key metrics of the business: uses data to diagnose issues, prioritize investment and forecast accurately, and builds business cases that influence executive stakeholders

  • Strong executive presence: builds credible relationships with CISOs, CIOs and other senior buyers, and communicates strategy, performance and investment plans to senior leadership with clarity

  • Strong eye for talent, both in hiring and in advancing the careers of Vantans

  • Comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to create clarity for a team through periods of rapid growth and change

  • Enthusiasm for cybersecurity and for helping customers build trusted businesses

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

This role requires an in-office hybrid schedule, with 3 days per week in the London office.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. THE ROLE

We are looking for a hands-on Video Systems Engineer to operate the technical backbone behind our content delivery — for linear TV channels and video-on-demand. You will manage systems and configurations to ensure seamless processes from ingestion to delivery. In this deeply operational role, you will work on all video content available on the Zattoo platform and collaborate with teams from different departments like Product, Content, and Data Center to ensure the best experience for our users and tenants.

THE VIDEO OPERATIONS TEAM

You'll join the team responsible for everything between the satellite dish and the viewer's screen — headend operations, satellite and IP ingest, encoding, and channel configuration across our entire live TV lineup.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Configure new and maintain existing linear TV channels on the Zattoo platform, including capabilities like catch-up, subtitles, HbbTV
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders on channel acquisition to ensure a fast integration and smooth operations
  • Own and maintain our DVB-S headends in close collaboration with the data center team, configuring FTA and encrypted satellite ingests and planning needed capacities
  • Coordinate the integration of IP signal providers, plan topics like bandwidth, redundancy, and other technical parameters, or via SRT, ZiXi, and similar
  • Support the VOD ingestion process
  • Configure and manage the different server pools, which are used for encoding and transcoding
  • Procure, configure and maintain all the professional equipment and software
  • Maintain configuration and document relevant specifications to have easy access to a catalogue of channels existing on the platform
  • Diagnose and resolve faults across the signal chain
  • Support monitoring, alerting and incident response

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • Hands-on experience configuring, managing and maintaining linear TV channels on a broadcast or streaming platform
  • Solid understanding of the DVB standards, satellite fundamentals, as well as standards such as MPEG-TS
  • Experience configuring and maintaining professional satellite receivers and IRDs (e.g. Teleste, AppearTV).
  • Practical knowledge of encoding and transcoding - encoding parameters, audio track handling and subtitle integration.
  • Familiarity with low-latency ingest protocols such as SRT and Zixi.
  • Comfortable with structured fault diagnosis, also under pressure
  • Good communication skills
  • Bonus:
    • Scripting skills in Python or Bash for automation
    • Knowledge of FAST channels and SCTE-35 markers
    • Familiarity with IP multicast and content protection, or a genuine interest and understanding of the TV and broadcast industry landscape

WHY JOIN US?

At Zattoo, you’re always on firm ground with real freedom to explore. You’ll have the support and opportunity you need to go far, while you’re helping us create a sustainable and entertainment-filled future for all.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

  • Reward: strong market competitive salary
  • Recharge: 30 days vacation plus public holidays
  • Regulate:trust based flexible working hours and the option for remote work worldwide for up to 8 weeks per year

Plus:

  • We’re sharing: Free access to the best streaming experience on the market
  • We're developing: Your own development budget, German classes and Zattoo all-company hack days
  • **We’re inclusive: ‘**Zattooies’ are a fun, engaged, and diverse team made up of 47 nationalities
  • We’re healthy: Health checks, mental wellbeing support, team sports and more!
  • We’re mobile: discounted BVG tickets and free bike rentals
  • We’re sociable: A calendar of events with fireside chats, lunches, in-house bar, BBQ’s, monthly socials, summer party and an annual off-site event

Zattoo enables our users to view indiscriminately and we reflect that in our team too. Regardless of race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability or any other characteristic protected by law we encourage everyone to apply and will give everyone equal consideration. We are an equal opportunities employer — join us and help build a diverse team dedicated to revolutionising the way you watch TV.

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

The opportunity:

As our Programme Manager (d/f/m) in the Office of the CFO within the G&A organization, you'll sit at the heart of one of the most strategically important functions at Taxfix. Reporting directly to the CFO and working closely with G&A leadership, you'll be the connective tissue that keeps critical initiatives moving — from shaping how we communicate our story, to driving the operational rhythms that make a high-performing G&A team tick.

You'll also play a key role in how we build and scale AI-native ways of working within G&A, identifying where intelligent tooling can sharpen decision-making, accelerate execution, and give the CFO's office a genuine edge. You don't just recommend — you build. You know when to think and when to act, and you're comfortable moving from insight to working solution. This is a role for someone who thrives on complexity, earns trust quickly, and knows how to turn ambiguity into momentum. If you're energized by working at the intersection of strategy, execution, and emerging technology, and you're ready to make a real impact on a company that's changing how millions of people relate to their finances: we'd love to meet you!

  • Initiate and guide the OKR process for G&A, coordinating inputs across the leadership team and ensuring goals are ambitious, measurable, and well-communicated.

jobs.title: Partner Engagement Manager, U.S. Army Europe and Africa
jobs.description:
Consequential Work. Dedicated People.


About Onebrief

Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

Required: Top Secret clearance with eligibility for SCI

In person in Grafenwöhr, Germany

 

Why This Role Exists

As a Partner Engagement Manager at Onebrief, you're the customer's trusted technical partner. You serve as the subject-matter expert, maintaining power-user-level fluency in the platform. You stay current on product updates, translating new releases into practical impact for the specific workflows your customer relies on. You act as the primary line of communication between the customer and Onebrief — as the product evolves, you deliver ongoing, role-specific training to ensure users adopt new capabilities rather than getting stuck on outdated workflows. You bridge the technical gap between engineering and the customer, explaining product behavior in terms their staff can actually act on.

 

What You’ll Do

Core responsibilities:

  • Clearly communicate user needs to the product team. Maintain a high product proficiency, and excite the customer about each product improvement.

  • Understand, request, and effectively leverage Company resources to meet the goals of the Company.

  • Lead or support exercises.

  • Use your observations of our users to recommend product improvements.

  • Identify gaps between existing directorate workflows and effective Onebrief usage, then drive adoption through hands-on configuration, user coaching, and workflow optimization.

  • When responding to incidents (product is unavailable, broken, or not delighting the customer), coordinate with the customer and our product engineering team.

  • Align your team’s efforts to deliver the best customer experience, while coordinating with fellow Partner Engagement Managers to ensure planning and workflows remain synchronized across commands.

  • Enable expansion and upsell opportunities to Allies and Partners by instilling the Onebrief value proposition.

 

Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven experience in leading operational planning within a military context, preferably at multi-star headquarters.

  • Exposure to large staff planning, through classical training in Professional Military Education or through service experience

  • Familiarity and experience with major military planning exercises and the protocols for software deployment on classified networks.

  • Proven ability to expand business presence within a customer location with emphasis on software or technology solutions.

  • Experience in customer support, both face-to-face and remote, and capability to respond to incidents coordinating with customers and product engineering teams.

  • Strong technical skills to master our application, troubleshoot issues and liaise with customers on technical matters.

  • Proven ability to navigate large government organizations, solve bureaucratic challenges, and deliver successful outcomes.

  • You hold a current Top Secret clearance with eligibility for SCI and have the ability to access DOD facilities and installations.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • You’re technically adept. You don’t need to code, but you do need to be savvy. Can you become a power user of our product and talk engineering with the customer?

  • Customers trust you. You demonstrate strong interpersonal skills, develop rapport, align diverse perspectives, and communicate with clarity and influence.

  • You’re intense about our mission. It’s a core part of who you are

  • You’re proactive and adaptable. You see a problem and get to work. You’re comfortable working autonomously or in a cross-functional team, especially in a fast-paced or ambiguous setting

  • You communicate clearly, concisely, and candidly. Our Company relies on you to assess the situation within your account and effectively communicate your assessment and recommendations to inform strategic decisions.

 

Indicators of Success

This role will evolve as priorities change, but the outcomes below reflect what success typically looks like in the first six months.

A successful Partner Engagement Manager will:

  • Opinion and expertise are valued by the customer and company alike (rapport/trust)

  • Learns quick, identifies opportunities and drives progress within the account (Forward-leaning/ bias for action)

  • Open-minded and able to pivot when priorities shift (Adaptability/ Humility)


Notice to Third Party Recruitment Agencies
Please note that Onebrief does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of an executed Recruitment Services Agreement, there will be no obligation to any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without an agreement Onebrief explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, shall be deemed the property of Onebrief.

jobs.title: Head of Operations
jobs.description:
We're customer obsessed. We put the customer at the heart of everything we do - and we're looking for people who feel the same way.

About Bike Club

Bike Club is the easiest way to keep kids on the right sized bike. Through our subscription model, we remove the hassle of buying, outgrowing and reselling children's bikes, so families always have the right bike, right when they need it. We are a purpose led, fast-growing business built on ease, care, progress and joy - with a relentless focus on customer growth, retention and building a more circular approach to children's cycling.

Purpose of the Role

The Head of Operations owns the system that runs Rainham: the plan, the standard, the data and the forward view. This is a new role, created as Rainham becomes both a refurb centre and a national distribution site from January 2027.

This is a planning, analytical and continuous improvement role first as well as a people management role. The Head of Operations will build the system the warehouse team, mechanic team and distribution team deliver against and will be ultimately accountable for whether the site performs both efficiently and effectively.

Tasks

Key Responsibilities

1. Demand, capacity and forward planning

  • Own capacity planning end to end: built stock cover, inbound space, returns and disposal flow, physical site capacity as the site takes on distribution volume.
  • Build and stress test the peak plan well ahead of demand, including Christmas peak, modelling labour, space and carrier capacity against it.
  • Run rigorous what-if scenario planning: model the impact of demand shifts, supply delays, absence and carrier disruption before they happen, not after.
  • Set build volume targets from demand and the labour model that delivers them, and own whether the number lands.

2. Data, systems and reporting

  • Own data integrity across the site: build, dispatch and inventory reporting must reconcile, and any variance is investigated, not repeated.
  • Fluent in Salesforce (ideal) and confident evaluating or evolving a WMS suited to the site's needs as it scales.
  • Own the design of scanning, location and inventory status processes/workflow that the Distribution Manager and Mechanic Team execute.
  • Build the reporting the business needs to trust: no repeat of build numbers running on an unvalidated figure

3. Inventory and stock governance

  • Own inventory accuracy, cycle count governance and disposal authorisation across the site
  • Set the reorder points and supplier process for packaging and consumables for the Distribution Manager to own and execute upon.
  • Reconcile stock movements regularly and investigate variance as standard daily practice - not as a reaction to a discovered problem.

4. Performance framework and quality

  • Design and own the performance framework: what good output looks like, how it is measured, and when it is escalated
  • Design the QC gates built into both the build and despatch process, so defects are caught by design and automation where applicable.
  • Set the standard for order completeness and despatch accuracy, and firmly hold the site to it.
  • Own the formal performance management framework, including how underperformance is identified, documented and addressed

5. Continuous improvement

  • Continuous improvement is a default operating habit of this role, not a project or an initiative

About the role:

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer, Quality to build the agentic layer of how Camunda tests its software.

We treat quality as an engineering discipline. We build test infrastructure the way we build our product — real design decisions, real trade-offs, real ownership. What's changing is how that work gets done: we're moving from hand-written test suites toward agents that design, generate, maintain and triage tests across the lifecycle. We need someone to build both the agents and the infrastructure that makes them dependable, and to help shape our Quality AI strategy.

You'll support product teams that ship features without dedicated QA. Your job is not to become their testing safety net. It's to build the tooling and practices that let builders own quality themselves — and to stay close enough to real features to know where that tooling breaks.

Camunda also ships AI capabilities in its own product, so the evaluation practice you build for agent-driven testing feeds directly into how we test non-deterministic features.

You'll join colleagues who live our FAITH values: Focus, Ambition, Integrity, Talent and Humor.

jobs.title: Professional Services Engineer - Cloudflare Implementation
jobs.description:
About BRIXIO

BRIXIO is a cybersecurity and cloud services provider and a Cloudflare Authorised Service Delivery Partner, dual certified in Application Security & Performance and Cloudflare One.

We design, implement and operate Cloudflare environments for enterprise and public-sector clients across Europe, the Gulf and Asia, with operations spanning Casablanca, Paris, Luxembourg, Dubai and Singapore.

Since July 2026, BRIXIO has been part of Equans, a Bouygues group company, combining our specialist focus and technical expertise with the scale, stability and career opportunities of a major international organisation.

The Role

As a Professional Services Engineer, you will design, build and implement Cloudflare environments for BRIXIO's French-speaking enterprise and public-sector clients and help take them successfully into production.

This is a hands-on implementation role covering onboarding, migration from existing CDN and WAF platforms, WAF and DDoS deployment, Zero Trust rollout, DNS cutovers, SASE and production hardening.

You will work within properly planned and governed client projects. The Delivery Manager owns the project plan and delivery governance, while the Principal Architect provides technical authority and owns the overall design.

Your responsibility is the build, validation and client-facing technical implementation.

The client portfolio includes French banks, industrial groups, public bodies and media organisations. You will regularly work directly with their technical teams in French, explaining what you are implementing, why particular decisions have been made and how production changes will be managed.

This is not a back-office engineering role.

We are hiring at two levels:

  • Senior Engineer: capable of owning a Cloudflare migration end to end and independently leading technical conversations with clients.
  • Mid-Level Engineer: strong network/security fundamentals and implementation experience, with the opportunity to deepen Cloudflare expertise through structured training and certification.

What You Will Do

Cloudflare Implementation & Migration

  • Configure and deploy Cloudflare environments across DNS, CDN and caching, WAF, DDoS mitigation, rate limiting, load balancing, Bot Management, Zero Trust and Access, tunnels and SASE components.
  • Deliver migrations from incumbent platforms, particularly Akamai and other CDN/WAF providers.
  • Handle rule translation, traffic cutover planning, staged deployment and rollback design.
  • Plan and execute production DNS cutovers, ensuring a validated rollback is available at every stage.
  • Build and deliver pilots and proofs of concept, from individual applications through to full production rollouts.
  • Test, validate and tune deployed environments, including cache-hit ratio, latency, WAF false positives and other client-relevant performance characteristics.

Client-Facing Technical Delivery

  • Lead technical working sessions with client teams in French, including workshops, configuration reviews, cutover rehearsals and go-live calls.
  • Explain technical decisions, risks and implementation considerations clearly to both engineers and management stakeholders.
  • Produce client-facing technical documentation in French and English, including configuration records, runbooks, cutover plans and project-closure documentation.
  • Identify and raise technical or delivery risks as soon as they become visible rather than allowing them to surface late in the project.

Working Within the Delivery Model

  • Work according to the project plan established by the Delivery Manager.
  • Provide clear and accurate progress updates and flag potential delays or blockers early.
  • Escalate architecture and design questions to the Principal Architect rather than making unapproved architectural changes during delivery.
  • Maintain accurate project timesheets and record effort against the appropriate projects.
  • Identify and communicate potential out-of-scope client requests to the Delivery Manager.
  • Deliver a structured handover into managed services at project closure, including complete documentation, runbooks and known risks, allowing the support team to operate the environment effectively from day one.

Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing

  • Work with implementation engineers in Dubai and Poland, managed services teams in Morocco and the Philippines, and pre-sales and architecture teams in France.
  • Use Zoho Projects and BrixioOne as the source of truth for project tasks, documentation and reporting.
  • Contribute to BRIXIO's internal knowledge base and reusable implementation patterns and playbooks.
  • Support managed services teams with escalations requiring deeper implementation expertise.
  • Share technical knowledge across the wider delivery organisation.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

Technical Foundation

You should have a strong practical understanding of:

  • DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS and certificates
  • Proxies and reverse proxies
  • Caching and CDN mechanics
  • Web application architecture
  • Origin infrastructure
  • Cloud fundamentals across AWS, Azure or GCP

You should be able to clearly explain what happens between a browser and an origin infrastructure and confidently troubleshoot problems across that path.

You will also need a solid grounding in web application security, including:

  • WAF concepts
  • OWASP Top 10
  • Bot mitigation
  • DDoS attack patterns
  • Rate limiting

You should be comfortable using technical troubleshooting tools including:

  • curl
  • dig
  • traceroute
  • Browser developer tools
  • Packet capture tools where required

You should also have scripting and automation capability using technologies such as Python, Bash or Terraform, together with experience working with REST APIs.

Experience with Cloudflare Workers is a strong advantage.

Cloudflare Experience

For the Senior position, hands-on Cloudflare implementation experience is required.

For the Mid-Level position, Cloudflare experience is a strong advantage but is not mandatory where you bring strong experience with comparable CDN, WAF or Zero Trust technologies.

Candidates coming from platforms such as Akamai or other relevant CDN/security technologies can be considered where the underlying technical foundation is strong.

BRIXIO provides access to Cloudflare University, partner-only training and funded certification to support continued development.

Delivery Experience

Senior Engineer

  • 5+ years of experience implementing network, security or cloud infrastructure for external clients.
  • Demonstrated experience owning technical delivery within client-facing projects.
  • Hands-on Cloudflare implementation experience.
  • Ability to independently lead technical client discussions and implementation activities.

Mid-Level Engineer

  • 3+ years of relevant experience in network, security or cloud environments.
  • Alternatively, strong technical support or NOC experience combined with genuine implementation exposure.
  • Strong technical fundamentals and the ability to develop deeper Cloudflare expertise.

For Both Levels

  • Experience working within a professional services, consultancy, MSP or systems integrator environment with committed project timelines.
  • Experience with production cutovers or migrations under formal change control is a significant advantage.
  • Confidence working directly with external clients.

Languages

Full professional fluency in both French and English is a hard requirement.

French is the primary working language for this portfolio. You will conduct technical workshops, participate in cutover and go-live calls, and prepare client-facing technical documentation in French.

English is required for collaboration with BRIXIO's international teams and work involving Gulf and Asian accounts.

Both French and English will be assessed during the interview process.

Working Pattern

The role operates primarily during Central European working hours.

Some client migrations and production go-lives will require planned out-of-hours presence. These windows will be agreed in advance and compensated.

The position is remote from Morocco, with collaboration through the Equans IT Hub in Casablanca and occasional travel to client sites in France and elsewhere in Europe.

How You Work

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Rigorous and methodical when working with production environments.
  • Disciplined about documenting configurations and changes as work progresses.
  • Comfortable working directly with clients, including when communicating technical risks or problems.
  • Honest about the limits of their knowledge and willing to involve the Principal Architect when appropriate.
  • Able to distinguish between genuine technical blockers and issues that simply require additional implementation time.
  • Comfortable working remotely within an international team spanning Morocco, France, the Gulf, Poland and the Philippines.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means:

  • Cloudflare environments go live according to plan and perform in production as expected from testing.
  • Migrations are completed without unplanned downtime and with validated rollback procedures in place.
  • Clients develop confidence in your technical judgement and delivery.
  • Technical documentation is complete enough for managed services teams to operate environments without unnecessary dependency on the implementation engineer.
  • Project effort is recorded accurately, allowing delivery performance and invoicing to be managed correctly.
  • Knowledge gained during implementations becomes reusable across future BRIXIO projects.

Why BRIXIO?

  • Join one of a select number of Cloudflare Authorised Service Delivery Partners, working directly with Cloudflare engineering and support teams.
  • Be part of Equans and the Bouygues group, with the stability, scale and internal mobility of a major international organisation.
  • Develop genuine Cloudflare expertise through Cloudflare University, partner-only training and funded certification.
  • Work alongside a team that includes members of Cloudflare's Partner Technical Advisory Council.
  • Deliver substantial European enterprise and public-sector implementations through properly governed projects rather than ad hoc technical changes.

jobs.title: MSP Engineer, Network and Security - Rotating shifts
jobs.description:
About BRIXIO

BRIXIO is a cybersecurity and cloud services provider and a Cloudflare Authorised Service Delivery Partner, dual certified in Core Services and Cloudflare One.

We design, implement and operate Cloudflare environments for enterprise and public-sector clients across the Gulf, Europe and Asia, with offices in Casablanca, Paris, Luxembourg, Dubai and Singapore.

Since July 2026, BRIXIO has been part of Equans, a Bouygues group company, combining our specialist focus and technical expertise with the scale, stability and career opportunities of a major international organisation.

The Role

BRIXIO is building a genuine managed services capability — not simply a ticket queue.

As an MSP Engineer, you will operate client Cloudflare environments during your shift, combining reactive incident management with structured, proactive engineering.

You will detect and investigate issues before clients report them, resolve incidents within committed service levels, execute production changes under controlled processes, and carry out proactive activities designed to improve security, performance and service stability over time.

Managed services and support are delivered by the same team. This means your role spans both incident response and scheduled proactive work, with proactive engineering time protected within the rota rather than fitted around ticket volume.

You will be the technical responder on shift, but you will not carry an account alone. Client relationship management and reporting are owned by the Delivery Manager, while technical arbitration sits with the MSP & Support Lead.

There is no expectation to be reachable outside your scheduled shift.

Working Pattern

BRIXIO operates a follow-the-sun model across its teams in Morocco and the Philippines, designed around client demand and defined service coverage windows.

Early Shift

09:00–17:00 Morocco time

Provides full coverage during the core client peak window and is named on relevant client contracts.

Late Shift

15:00–23:00 Morocco time

Extends coverage across the peak window and includes an overlap and structured handover with the Early Shift.

Weekend Rotation

Weekend coverage is shared across the team on a reduced rotation. Sunday forms part of the service window for Gulf clients.

Shifts are managed through a published rota issued in advance, so you will know your schedule ahead of time.

Each shift change includes a 30-minute overlap and written handover, ensuring that engineers do not inherit undocumented situations.

Under the current operating model, Gulf night coverage is provided by colleagues in the Philippines within their normal working day. Shift patterns may evolve as the team and client base grow, with any changes discussed with the team in advance.

Weekend rotation is compensated in accordance with Moroccan law and Equans policy.

What You Will Do

Service Operations

  • Staff the client intake channel during your shift, qualify and triage incoming requests, and own first response within committed service levels.
  • Diagnose and resolve incidents across the Cloudflare stack, including WAF, DDoS mitigation, rate limiting, bot management, CDN and caching, DNS, TLS, load balancing, Zero Trust and Workers.
  • Qualify monitoring alerts, act on them using documented runbooks and create tickets where required.
  • Escalate appropriately and early to senior engineers, the MSP & Support Lead and Cloudflare Support in accordance with the escalation matrix.
  • Maintain accurate ticket records in Jira, including detection source, priority and timestamps, supporting accurate service-level reporting.

Change Execution

  • Execute production configuration changes under formal change control, including four-eyes validation and a documented rollback plan before deployment.
  • Provide named technical coverage during declared client go-live windows, including pre-go-live validation and active monitoring following cutover.
  • Maintain Cloudflare configuration as code using Terraform and version control.
  • Investigate and resolve configuration drift identified through automated nightly comparisons.
  • Ensure production changes are properly documented and traceable.

Proactive Engineering

  • Deliver scheduled proactive activities including configuration and security-posture audits, false-positive analysis, cache and rate-limit calibration, DNS and certificate hygiene, and unused-rule cleanup.
  • Analyse traffic and security telemetry using Cloudflare Analytics, GraphQL API and log data to identify potential problems before they affect clients.
  • Recommend and implement security and performance improvements and demonstrate their impact.
  • Contribute to root-cause analysis following major incidents.
  • Identify recurring causes and raise them through the problem-management process so they can be eliminated rather than repeatedly resolved.

Collaboration & Knowledge

  • Work closely with client NOC and security teams, including participation in operational channels and major incident bridges where BRIXIO is integrated with the client's teams.
  • Write and maintain runbooks, Standard Operating Procedures and configuration documentation in Confluence.
  • Support BRIXIO's professional services and implementation teams during escalations and handovers into managed service.
  • Actively share technical knowledge across the team to reduce dependency on individual engineers.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

Technical Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in network, security or cloud operations.
  • Experience within managed services, NOC or SOC environments is a strong advantage.
  • Solid working knowledge of DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, proxies, caching and CDN mechanics.
  • Practical Cloudflare experience across WAF, DDoS mitigation, rate limiting, bot management, CDN and DNS.
  • Where Cloudflare experience is partial, BRIXIO will fund Cloudflare certification, which you will be expected to complete within the first six months.
  • Confidence using diagnostic tools including curl, dig, traceroute, browser developer tools and HAR analysis.
  • Experience with Terraform for Infrastructure as Code.
  • Experience with Git/version control.
  • Scripting capability using Python or Bash.
  • Understanding of web application architecture and application-security fundamentals.
  • Familiarity with Jira Service Management and ITIL-aligned incident, change and problem-management processes.
  • Exposure to observability and monitoring platforms.
  • Experience with AWS, Azure or GCP is an advantage.

Languages

Full professional fluency in both French and English is a hard requirement.

You will handle incidents both in writing and verbally with French- and English-speaking enterprise clients, including during high-pressure situations. You will also prepare client-facing incident and change records in both languages.

Both French and English will be assessed during the interview process.

Arabic is a significant advantage when supporting BRIXIO's Gulf accounts.

How You Work

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Calm and methodical when working under incident pressure.
  • Disciplined about escalation rather than improvising when the situation requires additional expertise.
  • Serious about documentation and maintaining accurate technical records.
  • Able to explain technical situations clearly to non-technical stakeholders in either French or English.
  • Comfortable acknowledging what they do not know and finding the right answer.
  • Reliable within a rotating shift environment and disciplined about providing clean handovers to colleagues.
  • Comfortable working remotely within a distributed international team spanning Morocco, the Philippines, France and the Gulf.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means:

  • Increasing numbers of issues are detected and resolved proactively before clients report them.
  • Service-level commitments are consistently met, with any breaches accurately documented and understood.
  • Recurring incidents are progressively eliminated, reducing reactive workload over time.
  • Production changes are executed safely, with rollback plans prepared even when they are not needed.
  • Shift handovers are clean, tickets are accurate and runbooks remain current.
  • Clients develop confidence in the engineers operating their environments.
  • Proactive engineering contributes measurably to improved security, performance and service stability.

Why BRIXIO?

  • Join one of a select number of Cloudflare Authorised Service Delivery Partners, working directly with Cloudflare engineering and support teams.
  • Be part of Equans and the Bouygues group, with the stability, scale and career mobility of a major international organisation.
  • Develop genuine Cloudflare depth through access to Cloudflare University, partner-only training and funded certification.
  • Join a managed service designed around defined processes, published rotas, protected proactive engineering time and no expectation of being reachable outside your shift.
  • Develop towards Senior MSP Engineering, Professional Services Implementation, Solution Architecture or Service Delivery Management.
  • Work in an environment where automation is part of the engineering role, with engineers encouraged to contribute to and improve BRIXIO's internal tooling.

About Edra

Edra is solving one of the hardest problems in enterprise AI: AI models are generic but company processes are specific. We build AI agents that learn how processes actually run, and then run their operations.

We're a Series A startup, backed by Sequoia and other leading VC firms, led by Co-Founders who created and led Forward Deployed AI Engineering at Palantir, and we're growing our team in New York and London. The Role

You'll work across the full design process—from early research and ideation through to polished, shipping designs—collaborating closely with engineering, product management, and other stakeholders.

  • Own design for key product areas, taking ambiguous problems and turning them into clear, elegant solutions

jobs.title: Sales Director
jobs.description:
What we are building at Conveo

Conveo is the AI research platform enabling fast, affordable, and high-quality consumer / B2B research. Global brands like Unilever, Google, and Orange use our AI video interviewer to generate insights across marketing and product teams.

 

#1 What problem are we solving, and why is this an important problem to solve

The current/traditional research methods companies rely on are slow, expensive, and superficial. Running great research also requires expertise, which is a blocker to many companies. That directly affects how well companies understand their customers and how well they can serve them.

 

#2 The team you will join

You will join an extremely talented team of incredibly passionate, high-energy people. We go the extra mile while having the best time of our lives. Our team has the combination of decades of market research knowledge, incredible engineering ability, and experience building companies.

 

#3 How we operate

  • We truly care about our clients and the problem we solve. That means we humbly go the extra mile every time.

  • We work hard, and we have fun.

  • To keep our quality bar incredibly high, we want to execute with the smallest possible team.

 

The Role

As a Sales Director at Conveo, you’ll take full ownership of the sales cycle — from building pipeline to closing enterprise deals and expanding accounts. You’ll partner directly with the founders to refine our go-to-market strategy while landing and growing some of the world’s biggest brands. This is a high-impact role where you’ll navigate complex orgs, multi-stakeholder deals, and long sales cycles ($45K-$500K+), selling into industries like CPG, Pharma, Tech, and Financial Services.

 

Your Mission

1. Create Demand & Build Pipeline

  • Own a defined ICP and territory plan, executing multi-threaded outreach (email, LinkedIn, calls).

  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads with crisp discovery and problem framing.

  • Build and maintain 4–5× pipeline coverage to hit and exceed quota.

2. Win Deals & Expand Accounts

  • Lead consultative discovery and run tailored demos tied to customer workflows and KPIs.

  • Navigate complex buying committees (economic buyer, users, procurement, legal) and manage deal timelines.

  • Negotiate and close clean, scalable contracts; expand initial wins into multi-market, multi-year agreements.

3. Be the Market & Product Expert

  • Translate customer pain points into compelling ROI cases.

  • Stay on top of competitor moves and market trends to sharpen messaging and objection handling.

  • Capture customer success stories and proof points that strengthen Conveo’s market narrative.

4. Partner with Founders & Marketing

  • Provide structured product feedback to shape roadmap priorities.

  • Collaborate on campaigns, content, and sequences to boost funnel conversion.

  • Maintain crisp CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.

 

What Success Looks Like

  • Qualified pipeline coverage (≥4–5× quota), stage velocity, and win-rate improvements.

  • Strong win rates (high stage-to-stage conversion, clean qualification/disqualification, and rising expansion (multi-market/multi-year, increased ACV & ARR ).

  • Referencable customers and repeatable plays we can roll out across the team.

 

What we’re looking for

  • 5–15 years of enterprise sales in SaaS, Martech, or Market Research.

  • Track record of closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals (ACV $75K+) with long sales cycles.

  • Experience selling to Fortune 500 companies.

  • Great if you have a strong network or background in market research, insights, or consulting.

  • High energy, self-motivation, and a relentless drive to win.

  • Excellent communication skills — active listener, persuasive storyteller, and trusted advisor.

  • Comfortable with CRM tools (HubSpot, Salesforce) and multi-channel outreach.

  • Team player who thrives in a fast-paced, low-politics, high-standards environment.

 

Why join us

At Conveo, you’ll join a team that genuinely enjoys working and spending time together. We care about building real relationships, not just great products. That’s why we run quarterly team off-sites where we disconnect, reset, and have fun. Our next one is a retreat in the Alps this March.

 

Plus

  • Own attention for a hyper-growth, YC-backed AI company.

  • Direct access to founders and high-leverage operators.

  • Help define how AI-powered research becomes the global default.

  • Competitive compensation with meaningful equity upside.

  • A culture built on taste, speed, ownership, and ambition.

  • Opportunities to travel globally and build real relationships with customers shaping the future.

jobs.description:
LemFi (Series B) is building the go-to financial app for the Global South.


Moving to a new country shouldn’t mean starting from zero. That's why our team of 400+ spanning 20+ countries is building a financial ecosystem that helps immigrants stay connected to home, build stability, and create wealth regardless of where they are from or where they live.


What began as fast, affordable remittances is now evolving into a complete platform for multi-currency accounts, payments, credit, and long-term financial growth.


With millions of users across the globe, we process over $1B in monthly transactions to 30+ countries, proving that borders shouldn't limit financial opportunity.

About the role

The Fincrime Product team builds and maintains the platform that protects LemFi and its customers from sanctions breaches, money laundering and fraud. As our Rules Modeller / FinCrime Analyst, you are the bridge between financial-crime risk and the systems that detect it: you own the tuning, thresholds and risk-scoring logic that decide what gets flagged, and you own the evidence that proves those decisions are sound.

This is a domain-led role on a small, senior team. You will spend your time in typologies, alert data and detection logic - reducing false positives without letting real risk slip through - working closely with Compliance, Investigations, Product and Engineering. Your tuning directly shapes both our operational cost and our regulatory posture across more than 21 countries and dozens of corridors.

What you'll build and own

  • Tune and maintain risk-scoring parameters, transaction-monitoring rules and screening match thresholds to reduce false positives while preserving coverage - and document every change with audit-ready evidence.

  • Analyse alert output and case feedback to recommend, test and implement threshold and logic changes; run above-the-line / below-the-line testing and periodic tuning cycles.

  • Translate emerging money-laundering, sanctions-evasion and fraud typologies into detection scenarios and rules, with clear written rationale and coverage assessments against LemFi's cross-border corridors.

  • Tune name and entity matching logic for sanctions, PEP and adverse-media screening across onboarding and ongoing checks; maintain customer and transaction risk-scoring segmentation aligned to risk appetite.

  • Build and interpret MI on alert volumes, false-positive rates and conversion to cases and SARs; produce tuning reports that leadership, auditors and regulators can rely on.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to specify changes, with Investigations for feedback loops, and with Compliance and the MLRO for policy and risk-appetite alignment.

  • Support internal audit, model-validation exercises and regulatory exams with a maintained, evidence-backed change log.

Your experience

  • Around 3 to 5 years in financial crime - transaction monitoring, sanctions screening and/or fraud - at a bank, fintech, payments provider or PSP.

  • Hands-on experience configuring or tuning TM and/or screening systems: rules, scenarios, matching logic or thresholds, not just reviewing outputs.

  • Solid working knowledge of AML/CTF, sanctions and fraud typologies and the regulatory expectations around monitoring and screening governance.

  • Comfortable working with data: reading and interpreting alert and transaction data, slicing it in spreadsheets, and using basic SQL to pull what you need (or a clear and demonstrated appetite to build that skill quickly).

  • Strong analytical and documentation skills - able to evidence and defend a tuning decision to an auditor or examiner in plain language.

  • A clear communicator who can translate between risk and systems, working across compliance, product and engineering without losing accuracy.

Nice to have

  • Experience in cross-border remittance, multi-corridor payments or a PSP operating across multiple jurisdictions.

  • Exposure to specific TM or screening vendors, and/or familiarity with Python or analysis notebooks.

  • Experience directly supporting internal audits or regulatory examinations.


Why Join LemFi?

Love shouldn’t be expensive, yet those working hardest for their families often face predatory fees and banking exclusion. We're changing this.

At LemFi, you won’t be just a cog in a machine. Whether designing products, scaling operations, or telling our story, you’ll tackle complex challenges with real, immediate impact. Your work goes beyond metrics - it puts money back in families’ pockets and offers access to the previously excluded. Join us to make a meaningful difference, where high performance is a lifeline for millions.

We now want to go further and faster, with someone fully dedicated to understanding what turns a conversation into a purchase, and to proving it with data.

jobs.title: Data Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
🏨 The company

Resilience Care is a leading medical remote monitoring player and a clinical research partner. Founded in France in 2021, our mission is simple: improve patient care.
We build remote monitoring solutions in oncology, gastroenterology and psychiatry, powered by ePRO collection and AI techniques. Our platform helps care teams detect side effects early for continuous and proactive care, while our patient app helps people track and manage symptoms with tailored resources.
Our solutions optimize care pathways, enrich continuous patient understanding, and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring and detailed analysis of real-world data. Today, our solutions are deployed in routine care for 35,000 patients across 200+ healthcare institutions, and also support around twenty academic and industry clinical studies.
We put data at the service of care and therapeutic innovation, with the ambition to enable every patient to benefit from personalized medicine.

📝 Your role

In a nutshell: You join the Data Reliability Engineering (DRE) team to build, operate and secure the data platform that carries healthcare data from our production services to the people who use it — internal operational teams, clinical research users, and external partners receiving contractual data exports.

Your impact: Data arrives on time, complete, traceable and secure — and when it doesn't, we know before the users do. You turn one-off data requests and manual export procedures into automated, monitored, reproducible pipelines.

Your day-to-day:

  • Build and operate data pipelines : ingestion from application events & databases, transformation, export.

  • Build the tooling that handles those pipelines, hand in hand with SRE: infrastructure as code (Terraform, Helm on Kubernetes), deployment, CI/CD, secrets management, database operations and incident response.

  • Watch over data quality and pipeline health: Grafana dashboards, alerting, and metric- and log-based observability, so failures are detected and diagnosed fast.

  • Own data contracts and data quality: agree with the emitting squads on schemas, semantics and breaking-change rules, and enforce them with automated tests (freshness, completeness, referential integrity) that fail loudly before the data reaches its users.

  • Deliver secure data exports to external partners and institutions.

  • Provision and maintain dedicated PostgreSQL Research Spaces for clinical study teams, including access control and data scoping per study.

  • Help the modelers scale their work: industrialize the dbt project so a single modelisation written by a Data Analyst is centralized, parallelized and applied across several targets.

  • Work directly with the requesters: scope the need, challenge it, agree on what is feasible, deliver, and document.

  • Work with the product squads on the data they emit: challenge their design upstream, and take part in the implementation on their side (TypeScript) when needed — you contribute to their code, they keep their roadmap.

  • Participate in code reviews, technical design and continuous improvement of engineering standards.

✨ Your team

  • Your future teammates: Mélody Ballouard and Alric Gaurier — Data Reliability Engineers.

The team owns the data pipeline end to end: ingestion, transformation, exports, and the infrastructure underneath. You'll be exposed to all of it from day one.

  • Your manager: Alric Gaurier

  • Team's extra: A small team with direct exposure to clinical research, medical and operational stakeholders. What you build is used by named people you talk to every week — not by an anonymous backlog.

👤 What we are looking for

  • ⚙️ You are the right person if you can:

    • Ship production-grade Python (tests, typing, code quality, reviews, CI), and use AI tools as a multiplier without letting go of engineering ownership.

    • Build and operate data pipelines and orchestration (Prefect, Airflow, Dagster or equivalent), including event streams (Kafka) and object/file transports (S3, SFTP).

    • Write and optimize advanced SQL on PostgreSQL (indexing, query plans, incremental loads).

    • Push dbt well beyond basic usage: macros and Jinja, multi-target projects, incremental strategies, tests, packages and CI integration.

    • Deploy and operate what you build (Terraform, Helm/Kubernetes, containers, CI/CD), with meaningful monitoring and alerting (Grafana or equivalent) — and lead the diagnosis when something breaks.

    • Read and contribute to TypeScript codebases when the pipeline meets the application side, with a solid grasp of back-end API architecture (REST design, versioning, authentication, pagination, contracts).

  • 🙂 You are the right person if you have:

    • Strong communication skills — this is not a nice-to-have in this role. You will spend real time with non-technical requesters.

    • The ability to translate an operational or scientific need into a technical specification, and to say no (and explain why) when a request is not feasible or not compliant — with the support of the Legal/Compliance department.

    • Comfort collaborating with SRE on shared infrastructure, and with scientific profiles on clinical trial data.

    • Rigor with sensitive data: you treat patient data with the caution it deserves, by reflex.

    • Ownership, autonomy and accountability, including on-call-style responsibility for what you ship — with a structured, detail-oriented approach, a bias for automation, and a focus on impact and maintainability.

    • Curiosity and a continuous-learning mindset — the reflex to go beyond your own stack: reading a product squad's code, digging into an API or an infrastructure layer you don't own, and learning what you need to unblock yourself instead of waiting for someone else.

  • 📃 You are the right person if you have already:

    • ~4–6 years in data engineering, platform engineering, or backend with a strong infrastructure component.

    • Operated production pipelines you were accountable for (not just built them).

    • Written and reviewed infrastructure as code in a team setting.

    • Delivered data to stakeholders outside your own team, and handled the conversation that goes with it.

    • Worked in a maintained codebase (Git workflow, PRs, CI).

    • Operated in a context with high standards (security, compliance, sensitive data).

  • It's a plus if you:

    • Have exposure to healthcare data, GDPR-heavy or HDS-hosted environments.

    • Have supported scientific or clinical research users (study datasets, cohort extraction, data requests from investigators).

    • Have handled contractual data exchanges with external partners (data transfer agreements, delivery SLAs, encryption requirements).

💛 Why join us?

  • A mission that holds up: improving patient care with data.

  • Real ownership over a full platform — pipelines and the infrastructure they run on — not a narrow slice.

  • Direct contact with the people your work serves, including clinical research teams running active studies.

  • A culture focused on automation, observability and continuous improvement, with practical AI usage.

  • Remote-friendly setup and an environment that values quality, standards and ownership.

Hiring process

  1. Screening - Elena (15 min): validate motivation and role prerequisites

  2. Manager Fit - Alric (30 min): position fit, and an honest conversation about the ops-and-build nature of the role

  3. Technical Case Study - live session (1h30), no preparation: you work through a small realistic case with us — pipeline design, infrastructure and data export constraints. We look at how you reason and what you ask, not at a polished deliverable.

  4. Team fit : Fit interview Mellody, Anna, Guillaume (30 min): collaboration fit with Research/Clinical and operational requesters

  5. Culture fit - Elena (40 min): assess alignment with our culture and remote ways of working

  6. Strategic Fit Jullian (30 min): collaboration fit, engineering standards

GDPR : Your personal data will be processed for the purposes of recruitment related activities, which include setting up and conducting interviews and tests for applicants, evaluating and assessing the results thereto, and as is otherwise needed in the recruitment and hiring processes. They will be available only for people involved in the process and erased after 2 years of inactivity.

Under GDPR and as Resilience attach great importance to privacy, please note that you have the right to request access to your personal data, to request that your personal data be rectified or erased.   • A founding mandate in a brand-new, centralized operations function — you'll help shape how it works from day one.
  • Direct line of sight into Qonto's banking license transition, raising the bar on operational rigor as the company scales.
  • Real autonomy over a strategic mission with executive visibility into the outcome.
  • A seat at the table as a genuine business partner to Finance and factory leadership, not just an operator.

➡️ Your future manager

Most recently as VP Operations at Combo, she ran RevOps, Enablement, and Data teams, drove a post-merger integration, and launched a new Payroll Business Unit from scratch. She's been an operator, a builder, and a manager of managers.

Almost any company can produce training video at scale today. Almost none can tell you whether it actually made someone better at their job. We're building the product that closes that gap: an agentic, real-time experience where people practice live, dynamic scenarios, and where organizations finally get genuine signal on readiness, instead of a metric tied to course completion. This is a zero-to-one bet on what comes after content, which is practice, and proof.

You'll own one of two of the domains inside that bet, Surveys and Guidance, from strategy through ship.

Why now

Real-time, agentic AI has only just become good enough to hold a convincing live scenario, and to make sense of what happens inside one. The window to define this category is open now, and we intend to own it.

The problem you're solving

Today, the most a company can do to check whether someone has genuinely learned something is watch them complete a module or pass a quiz. The behaviors that matter in real roles, in real moments, are rarely tested reliably, and what comes back to the business is a thin, lagging signal.

We have the underlying technology to change that. What we need is a product manager who can turn it into something an enterprise will use to prepare its people, and that an end user actually wants to engage with, across two connected domains:

  • Surveys - capturing structured, trustworthy signal at scale: how people feel, how they're performing, and where the gaps are.
